events.verdict: White (BOS) brings his arms forward as he establishes a screening position in Johnson's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as the pick is set.
Okongwu (ATL) is actively guarding an opponent within three seconds of entering the lane.
Johnson (ATL) legally contests Brown's (BOS) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Okongwu (ATL) establishes a slightly wide screening position in Tatum's (BOS) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as the pick is set.

Tatum (BOS) jumps in front and legally contests Young's (ATL) shot attempt. Tatum would miss Young completely if not for Young's unnatural leg extension, which makes contact with Tatum's leg. The contact is marginal and does not affect Tatum's ability to contest nor does it affect Young's shot attempt.
Johnson (ATL) brings his arm toward Brown's (BOS) path and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Brown (BOS) brings his off-arm towards Young's (ATL) space and marginal contact occurs as Brown releases away during the drive.

Hunter (ATL) steps forward and initiates illegal body contact with White (BOS), as he elevates. The contact is more than marginal and affects his driving shot attempt. Replay review of the foul called on Hunter (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful.
Johnson (ATL) and Brown (BOS) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Brown (BOS) makes marginal contact with Hunter's (ATL) body while defending over the screen during the inbound play.
Holiday (BOS) places his hand on Young's (ATL) side and marginal contact occurs as they come together off-ball.
Young (ATL) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
